description: Read-only review of a design system: inventory, consistency, accessibility and adoption findings without changing tokens or components.

stages.purpose: Extract the current token and component inventory with sources, consumers and inconsistencies.

gates.require: token sources, component list, themes, platforms and consumers are recorded with file or capture references; missing evidence stays UNKNOWN

stages.purpose: Evaluate rendered components and states against the quality-bar rubric, contrast and accessibility requirements, and report prioritised findings.

gates.require: findings name the token or component, the affected states and consumers, severity, evidence and a recommended owner-level fix
the audit states which components, themes and platforms were inspected and does not claim conformance or adoption it did not measure

policies.reason: Findings lack evidence; return to the inventory.
